response.original_title: Crystal Cruise Room Addition Guide: Step-by-Step Instructions
response.overview: To add a separate room to an existing Crystal Cruise reservation, you must call Crystal Cruise Customer Service directly +1-866-254-7549  or contact your travel agent +1-866-254-7549 , as this cannot be done online through the website or app. How to Add a Room Call Customer Service: Reach out to Crystal Cruises at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or call your original travel advisor. Book a Separate Cabin: Crystal's reservation system handles cabins individually. The agent will set up a new +1-866-254-7549 , separate booking for the additional stateroom based on current prevailing rates and availability. Link the Reservations: +1-866-254-7549  Ask the representative to cross-reference and link your booking numbers together.
